# midi-sequencer

> Read and write Standard MIDI Files byte for byte, preserving running status and unknown chunks, and merge tracks into a tempo-mapped event timeline in microseconds C++20 library `midi-sequencer`, namespace `trysac::midi_sequencer`, CMake target
> `trysac::midi_sequencer`, MIT licensed, standard library only.
